title: How Kratos' story really ends in God of War Ragnarök
subject: kratos
description:
Did Kratos earn his ending? 👇

The prophecy Kratos feared and Faye's hidden mural at the end of Ragnarök. Spoilers for God of War Ragnarök.

scenes.text: Kratos believed a prophecy said he would die in his son's arms.
In Jötunheim, a mural seemed to show Atreus holding his father's lifeless body.
So Kratos marched into Ragnarök expecting it to be his last war.
But that's not how it ended. Kratos survived, and Odin fell.
Then Atreus said goodbye and left alone to find the lost giants.
In a hidden shrine, Kratos found the panel Faye had concealed: people kneeling to him, a god who protects.
